name: FETV
description: FETV is a benchmark for fine-grained evaluation of open-domain text-to-video generation models. It categorizes prompts based on major content, control attributes, and prompt complexity, including temporal aspects tailored for video generation, enabling detailed analysis of model performance and metric reliability.
reputation: FETV is a specialized benchmark for fine-grained evaluation of text-to-video generation and is mainly used in research on video generation metrics.
notes: Includes multi-aspect and temporal-aware prompt categorization; reveals poor correlation of existing automatic metrics with human evaluation and proposes improved metrics.
